en.p: A pouch contains 6 cards with the natural numbers from 1 to 6 written on them, one each. A trial is performed in which one card is drawn at random from the pouch, the number on it is checked, and the card is put back. Let $\overline{X}$ be the mean of the four numbers checked when this trial is repeated 4 times. When $\mathrm{P}\left(\overline{X}=\dfrac{11}{4}\right)=\dfrac{q}{p}$, find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
